# changedetection_notification (Resource)

Create changedetection.io notifications

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "changedetection_notification" "all" {
  notification_urls = [
    "get://127.0.0.1/e",
    "get://127.0.0.1/a",
    "get://127.0.0.1/b",
    "get://127.0.0.1/c",
    "get://127.0.0.1/d",
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `notification_urls` (List of String) The list of notification urls.
